name: browser-use
headline: Deep Research Skill - Decision-Grade Research
short_description: A 7-phase research system for Claude Code that produces decision-grade, auditable, hallucination-resistant research outputs. Multi-source verification and Graph of Thoughts methodology ensure accuracy. Domain overlays for healthcare, financial, legal, and market research. Ideal for operations teams needing reliable, in-depth research.
author: standardhuman

sections.overview:
Deep Research Skill is a structured research automation system for Claude Code that classifies queries, executes parallel searches, and verifies claims across independent sources. It produces decision-grade outputs with complete citation trails, source catalogs, and evidence ledgers—eliminating unsourced claims and documenting contradictions. The system includes domain-specific overlays for healthcare (PMID/FDA citations), financial (SEC filings), legal (case citations), and market research (competitive intelligence). Each research project generates organized outputs including executive summaries, findings, recommendations, and QA reports. Operations and research teams use it to replace unreliable single-source AI responses with auditable, hallucination-resistant research.
Regulatory research requiring SEC filings and audited sources
Clinical or medical research with PMID and FDA references
Competitive market analysis and sizing
Legal research with case citations and jurisdiction requirements

sections.usage:
```
Perform deep research on [TOPIC] within the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use the 7-phase research system with multi-source verification and Graph of Thoughts methodology. Apply the [DOMAIN] overlay (healthcare, financial, legal, or market research) to ensure accuracy. Provide decision-grade outputs with clear citations.
```
